questions.stem: Which organelle is called the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out respiration and release energy (ATP), hence 'powerhouse'.

questions.stem: The basic unit of life is the
questions.explanation: All living things are made of cells, the basic structural and functional unit.

questions.stem: The gas taken in by plants during photosynthesis is
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water to make glucose, releasing oxygen.

questions.stem: The green pigment that traps light energy for photosynthesis is
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs light energy.

questions.stem: The genotype of a person who actually suffers from sickle cell anaemia is
questions.explanation: Only homozygous SS individuals express sickle cell disease; AS and AC are carriers.

questions.stem: The organ that produces bile is the
questions.explanation: The liver produces bile, which the gall bladder stores.

questions.stem: The human blood group regarded as the universal donor is
questions.explanation: Group O red cells carry no A or B antigens, so they can be given to any group.

questions.stem: The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants is called
questions.explanation: Transpiration is water loss mainly through the stomata of leaves.

questions.stem: Insects breathe through external openings called
questions.explanation: Air enters the insect tracheal system through spiracles.

questions.stem: The largest organ of the human body is the
questions.explanation: The skin covers the whole body and is the largest organ by area.

Mushrooms are saprophytic fungi, not plants.

questions.stem: Deficiency of vitamin C in the human diet causes
questions.explanation: Lack of vitamin C (ascorbic acid) causes scurvy, marked by bleeding gums and poor wound healing.
